title: shapa-llm: orphan pruner deletes arch/ files with drifted frontmatter (fixed, PR pending)
body: Root cause: shapa/nodes.py:27-29 is_protected() gates arch/ protection purely on frontmatter (meta["type"]=="reference"), never on path, despite AGENTS.md documenting a path-based guarantee (Files in arch/ ... are never pruned). Two real victims in open-trader/.shapa/arch/: moonshot-capture-rate-2026-07-31.md (type: reference nested under a metadata: block, not parsed - frontmatter.py has no nested-map support) and r4-poller-liveness-fix-2026-07-19.md (no frontmatter block at all). Both fell through to type="" -> unprotected -> deleted by heartbeat.py prune_orphans() since both had zero wikilinks. GitHub issue: https://github.com/Roukh/shapa-llm/issues/5. Fixing in shapa-llm repo (cross-project op-authorized) via TDD: add path-based arch/ protection independent of frontmatter.
